scientific_integrity: General proof is analytic; exhaustive four-contract tests are supplementary; originality has not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite many-to-many CY-stability with substitutable and individually rationally persistent choices, including empty choices; does not cover replacement-stability, incentives, welfare, or arbitrary lattice orders.
title: Universal antichain structure and greedy completeness of stable matchings under persistent substitutable choice
